name: Christopher DeMuth

lean.basis: Led the conservative American Enterprise Institute for 22 years, then Hudson and Heritage; co-organized the first National Conservatism conference and is one of the authors of its statement of principles.

sources.title: National Conservatism: A Statement of Principles — The American Conservative

current_role: Distinguished fellow, Heritage Foundation; National Conservatism conference organizer and Edmund Burke Foundation director
summary: Christopher DeMuth was president of the American Enterprise Institute from 1986 to 2008, then a fellow at AEI, the Hudson Institute (from 2012) and the Heritage Foundation (from 2023). In 2019 he joined Yoram Hazony in organizing the first National Conservatism conference and has chaired its sessions since; he is a director of the Edmund Burke Foundation.
